issue.title: sase-telegram gate tests still import removed plan/question gate creators
issue.description: Proposed by sase-x7.3.1.3 note #1; independently reproduced during sase-x7.3.1 landing against host ece5db3cc and sase-telegram 9cc66ab. tests/test_custom_gates.py fails collection importing sase.plan_gate.create_plan_approval_gate; test_gate_shell_settlement.py then fails importing its gate_home fixture. tests/test_inbound.py::TestHandleQuestionFlow::test_neutral_question_callback_uses_shared_executor imports removed create_user_question_gate. Both host APIs were removed by a646bdaf6 on 2026-08-27, before producer migration caa7917ac. Update the test gate setup to current build_plan_approval_gate_spec/user_question_gate_spec and the supported gate creation entrypoint, then run the complete plugin checks against current host. Do not reintroduce deleted compatibility APIs. Bounded medium task: precise deleted-API root, several fixture sites, shared fixture dependencies. Closed sase-hd is related but distinct: its old keyboard/kind expectations were fixed; this is a later API removal. No active epic caused these removals.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Deterministic missing imports: current source contains no create_plan_approval_gate/create_user_question_gate definitions. Independent pytest --collect-only gives exactly two collection errors. Phase sase-x7.3.1.3 also reproduced on its pre-change tree and reported 554 remaining tests passing.
